value.rationale: A first-onset and full-fiber classification for QPSK signals addresses natural phase-only retrieval of small quadrature-modulated waveforms. Unlike published scalar autocorrelation-energy minima, it distinguishes complete measurement fingerprints and shows exactly when the finite alphabet prevents identification: four two-orbit fibers at length six, forming one modulation orbit, including a binary-to-complex ambiguity. No arbitrary parameter slice or unmotivated table recomputation is needed.
